name: Viyash Scientific Ltd (formerly Sequent Scientific)
tagline: Carlyle-backed animal-health API+formulations player, merged with Viyash Life Sciences and pushing into human CDMO - an unproven turnaround with weak returns and a large-cap price tag
business_overview: Viyash Scientific (renamed from Sequent Scientific in Jan 2026) is a leading animal-health company - APIs and finished-dose formulations for livestock, poultry and companion animals, with manufacturing in India and Turkey - now combined with Viyash Life Sciences (an ~Rs 8,000 Cr all-stock merger announced 2024; both were Carlyle-controlled). The merged entity has ~16 plants (10 USFDA-approved) and is extending into human-pharma CDMO/CRAMS and specialty APIs, with a strategy centred on companion-animal therapeutics and 50:50 formulation partnerships with the likes of Cipla and Dr Reddy's.
fundamentals_table: Debt/equity ~0.73x; company has reduced debt; targeting debt-free by FY27 if no M&A
~50% via Sequent+Viyash synergies (better utilisation, product-mix upgrade)
fundamentals_narrative: Returns are currently weak (ROE ~5.4%, ROCE ~9.3%) and the merged group is still early in integration. Management's plan is a margin story - lift gross margin toward ~50% by better facility utilisation and shifting to higher-value products, divest non-value-added facilities, backward/forward integrate, and stay in 'pure therapeutics' (explicitly not pet food). The SeQuent API business targets a ~Rs 100 Cr/quarter run-rate and debt-free status by FY27 absent acquisitions. A Brazil-operations 'fraud' episode (2024) still weighs on sentiment. This is a plausible but unproven turnaround at a full price (~Rs 11,500 Cr on ~Rs 2,600 Cr revenue).
